title: A tool line carries its glyph once, in the mark column, in the transcript's tool colour
name: tool-colour
description:
Today a `tool` line in `apps/dashboard/src/logs/Logs.tsx` shows two marks:
- the generic `⚒` in the mark column, painted `var(--status-ready)` green (TONE.tool in `apps/dashboard/src/logs/data.ts`);
- the per-tool glyph from `TOOL` (◧ ✎ ✍ $ ⌕ ✱ ⧉ ⇣) inside the text, in dim ink.

The green means nothing (it is a status colour on a line that has no status), and the two marks fight.

The user chose one colour plus a glyph, as ADR 0064 records:
- The mark column holds the tool's glyph (fallback for an unlisted tool), painted `var(--tx-tool)` (periwinkle).
- The second copy in the text goes.
- The other transcript tones move to their ADR 0064 tokens (`--tx-error`, `--tx-human`, `--tx-think`).

There are no per-tool colour tokens and no new ADR. `sober logs` (`packages/cli/src/work.ts`) already puts the glyph in the mark column in blue, the nearest ANSI colour to periwinkle, so it only needs its comment aligned.

brief.approach:
The user chose one colour plus a glyph over per-tool colours, which is what ADR 0064 records. So: no per-tool tokens and no new ADR, because 0064 already covers the exception.

Dashboard only:
1. `apps/dashboard/src/logs/data.ts`: point `TONE` at the ADR 0064 tokens instead of borrowing status colours:
   - `tool` → `var(--tx-tool)`
   - `raw` → `var(--tx-error)`
   - `answer` → `var(--tx-human)`
   - `thinking` → `var(--tx-think)`
   Leave the rest as they are. Update the comment above `TONE` to cite ADR 0064. Keep `TOOL`, `TOOL_FALLBACK` and `toolMark` as they are.
2. `apps/dashboard/src/logs/Logs.tsx`: for a `tool` line, the mark column shows `toolMark(line.tool ?? '')` (the fallback when `tool` is null), painted with `TONE.tool`. Delete the second glyph copy inside the text span. The thinking dot uses `bg-[var(--tx-think)]` instead of `--status-running`. Nothing else in the file changes; tool-blocks rewrites the rest later.
3. `apps/dashboard/src/logs/Logs.test.tsx`: update 'a tool line shows its glyph, and an unlisted tool falls back'. A tool line renders its glyph exactly once, in the mark column, styled `var(--tx-tool)`. An unlisted tool shows `TOOL_FALLBACK`. Add a data test in `logs/data.test.ts`: no `TONE` value references `--status-ready`.

CLI: `packages/cli/src/work.ts` already puts the tool glyph in the mark column in blue, the nearest ANSI colour to periwinkle. Update only the comment on `TAIL` so it names ADR 0064 and `--tx-tool` as the dashboard counterpart. No behaviour change.

acceptance.proves: the tool glyph renders once in the mark column in --tx-tool, the fallback works, and no tone borrows a status colour
the run log no longer paints tool lines in a status colour
lint and format are clean for everything touched
